note: Homepage only. Two registers deliberately: skin_concerns tiles are HUMAN (portrait crops), find_serum tiles are MATERIAL (substance on ground). The same four concerns appear in both sections, so they must not read as the same grid twice. Hero is offered as three competing directions, not four candidates of one idea.

slots.title: Hero direction A — Portrait (the Tatcha/Sturm register)
slots.prompt: Editorial beauty photograph of one Caucasian woman around thirty five years old, a head and shoulders portrait, wearing a simple high necked charcoal knit top, positioned in the right half of the frame, turned three quarters toward the light and looking calmly just past the camera. Real skin kept real: visible pores, natural fine lines at the eye, slight natural unevenness, no airbrushing and no plastic smoothing. Almost no makeup, hair pulled back simply and away from the face. One hard key light from the upper right sculpts the cheekbone and jaw and leaves a soft controlled shadow down the left side of the face, with one dim cool fill. Behind her a seamless graphite studio backdrop, colour #1A1A1A, falling to near black toward the left edge. The left forty percent of the frame is empty graphite, even and unbroken, with no part of her entering it. Quiet, serious, expensive. 85mm lens at f4, medium format look, restrained cool grade, deep blacks.
slots.negative_extra: teenager, child, twenties, heavy makeup, glossy lips, false lashes, jewellery, smiling broadly, glamour retouching, plastic skin, airbrushed, beauty filter, oversaturated, white background

slots.title: Hero direction B — Product as art (refined A1)
slots.prompt: Relight and restage the exact bottle from the reference image. Keep the bottle unchanged: the same frosted glass cylinder graduating from deep blue at the shoulder to pale frosted blue at the base, the same brushed silver collar, the same matte white dropper bulb. Reproduce the front label exactly, every character verbatim, in the same order, colours and weights: a white dotted DNA double helix mark, the wordmark Skingenetix in bold white, COPPER PEPTIDE in bold white capitals beside a thin vertical blue rule, ADVANCED REPAIR SERUM in light blue bold capitals on two lines, PREMIUM FORMULA in plain white capitals below a thin rule, and 2% GHK-CU | 30ML in small white capitals. Do not add, remove or restyle any word. Compose the bottle standing upright in the RIGHT THIRD of the frame, well right of centre, its base on the lower third line, seen straight on at eye level, occupying about half the frame height. The ground is a seamless graphite sweep, colour #1A1A1A, lifting to a soft pool of light behind the bottle so the frosted glass separates cleanly from the background. One hard key from the upper right throws a long shadow down and to the left; a warm copper specular, colour #B87333, runs down the right edge of the glass. The left half of the frame is even graphite with no detail. Brighter and more open than a pure black studio shot, so the label stays legible at small size. Editorial product photography, 85mm at f11, deep clean blacks, high microcontrast.
slots.negative_extra: invented brand name, different brand, altered label, extra text, strapline, second bottle, carton, box, bottle centred in frame, bottle on the left, pure black featureless background, white background

slots.title: Hero direction C — Material (refined A2 serum arc)
slots.prompt: Extreme macro photograph of a single thick thread of clear viscous serum being drawn upward from a shallow pool, caught mid lift so it forms one continuous tapering strand that rises from the lower right and arcs across the right two thirds of the frame. The strand refracts a narrow clinical blue core, colour #014EB1, and carries a fine warm copper rim highlight, colour #B87333, along its upper edge. Beneath it a seamless graphite surface, colour #1A1A1A, polished to a wet sheen, returns one soft reflection. One hard raking key from the right at a shallow angle, one dim fill from the left. The left forty percent of the frame is empty even graphite with no detail and nothing entering it. The strand must read as liquid, soft and tapering and organic, not as a rigid glass rod or a solid handle. Editorial macro, 100mm at f8, deep clean blacks, high microcontrast, cool grade.
slots.negative_extra: glass rod, solid glass handle, glass sculpture, rigid arch, bridge, symmetrical loop, ice, plastic

slots.title: Science section — gloved hands, portrait crop
slots.prompt: Documentary photograph in an upright portrait format of one pair of blue nitrile gloved hands holding a single clear glass vial up against a dark laboratory background, turning it slightly to inspect the contents. Forearms enter from the bottom of the frame and the crop stops well below the shoulder so no face, head or body is visible. Behind, matte black instrument housings and a brushed steel bench are thrown far out of focus. One cool hard key from the upper left edge lights the glove and puts a bright specular on the glass; the background falls into deep shadow. Honest reportage, 85mm at f2, shallow depth of field, cool neutral grade, no styling.
slots.negative_extra: faces, heads, people, portraits, badges, readable screens, brand names on equipment, warm cosy light, staged

slots.title: Science section — molecular macro
slots.prompt: Upright macro photograph of a cluster of perfectly clear spherical droplets suspended in a shallow layer of clear fluid, arranged so they form one irregular chain running diagonally up the frame, each sphere refracting the one behind it. The chain reads as a molecular structure without being a diagram. Beneath is a seamless graphite surface, colour #1A1A1A, with a faint clinical blue glow, colour #014EB1, rising from below and a fine warm copper edge light, colour #B87333, catching the top of each sphere. One hard key from the upper right. Deep blacks around the edges of the frame. Scientific still life, 100mm macro at f11, high microcontrast, cool grade.

slots.title: Concern tile 1 — Fine Lines & Wrinkles (human register)
slots.prompt: Editorial beauty photograph, square format, of the upper face of one Caucasian woman around thirty five years old, cropped from just above the brow to just below the cheekbone so the eye area fills the frame. Real skin: faint early expression lines at the outer corner of the eye, natural texture, bare skin, no makeup beyond a trace of groomed brow. Her eye is open and calm, looking slightly off camera. One hard key from the left rakes across the skin so the fine lines read as real relief. The background is a soft pearl grey, colour #D8D6D4, seamless. The lower left quarter of the frame falls into a quiet even shadow so a caption can sit there. Restrained, dignified, not a problem photograph. 100mm at f5.6, natural skin tones, cool neutral grade.

slots.title: Page-break band — The Skingenetix Standard
slots.prompt: Studio photograph of a single upright machined cylinder of solid copper standing alone on a seamless graphite ground, colour #1A1A1A. The copper is lightly brushed with fine concentric turning marks, warm and unlacquered, colour #B87333, reading as a precision laboratory reference standard. It stands well right of centre, tall rather than squat, roughly twice as tall as it is wide, its base on the lower third line, and it is a solid closed cylinder, not an open cup or vessel. One hard key from the upper left throws a long specular down the body and casts one clean hard shadow to the lower right. The left forty five percent of the frame is unbroken graphite falling to near black, with no detail and no shadow entering it. Still life, 85mm at f11, deep blacks, metallic specular held, cool grade with warm metal.
